purpose: Make client handoffs complete and assign each next action to a role.
participation_notice: Participants may pass on any exercise or disclosure without employment consequences.
neutral_alternative: Review the fictional handoff checklist independently and propose a process improvement.

agenda.activity: Map decision owners and handoff fields.
Rehearse a request and recipient readback.

agreements.behavior: Each handoff names a next action, role owner, and due date.
The receiving role confirms missing inputs before accepting the handoff.

evidence.limits: General review; does not validate this session or promise a causal performance effect.
